overview.description: The Principal Spectrum Preferred and Income ETF (PQDI) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in broad credit fixed income. The fund actively selects dividend-paying securities that have favorable federal tax treatment, including preferred and capital securities, from global issuers. PQDI was launched on Jun 17, 2020 and is issued by Principal.
